verdict.rationale: GitHub states directly that you can "manage projects and assign tasks to Copilot, all from your mobile device" (github-docs-4). GitHub Mobile is documented as a way to do high-impact work from anywhere (github-docs-54), and GitHub's project tooling covers roadmaps through everyday tasks (github-docs-8, github-docs-12). Missing for 10: detailed docs on which project-board and assignment features work in the mobile app, evidence of assigning tasks to human teammates rather than only to Copilot, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile workflow.
